sdks.title: LayerFS
sdks.description: Projects, Branches, Commits, files, Sandboxes and Workspaces through the one `layerfs` package (Node: import layerfs from "layerfs") or the native `layerfs` command. Every call names its project as <store>/<project>; LAYERFS_HOME is set; the project key is in LAYERFS_CONNECT_PROJECT.

calls.name: project.init
calls.description: import a host folder as a new project into an existing Store

calls.name: project.list
calls.description: every project in the home, or one Store's

calls.name: project.get
calls.description: a project's record: its Store, kind and machine

calls.name: project.remove
calls.description: remove one project from its Store

calls.name: branch.list
calls.description: a project's Branches

calls.name: branch.get
calls.description: one Branch and its head Commit

calls.name: branch.fork
calls.description: a new Branch from another Branch's head or Commit

calls.name: branch.merge
calls.signature: layerfs.branch.merge(project, name, a, b, { message, units })
calls.description: merge two Branches into a new one

calls.name: branch.publish
calls.description: a Branch's head or Commit as main's next Layer

calls.name: branch.diff
calls.signature: layerfs.branch.diff(project, from_branch, to_branch, { paths_only, page_size, page_pos, cursor })
calls.description: files that differ between two Branches' heads

calls.name: commit.list
calls.description: a Branch's Commits, newest first

calls.name: commit.get
calls.description: one Commit of a Branch

calls.name: commit.diff
calls.signature: layerfs.commit.diff(project, from_commit, to_commit, { paths_only, page_size, page_pos, cursor })
calls.description: files that differ between two Commits

calls.name: file.read
calls.signature: layerfs.file.read(project, branch, path, commit?, { start_line, end_line })
calls.description: read a file

calls.name: file.stat
calls.description: a path's kind, size and mode

calls.name: file.list
calls.signature: layerfs.file.list(project, branch, path, commit?, { page_size, page_pos })
calls.description: a folder's entries

calls.name: file.glob
calls.signature: layerfs.file.glob(project, branch, path, pattern, commit?, { page_size, page_pos })
calls.description: paths under `path` matching a glob

calls.name: file.grep
calls.signature: layerfs.file.grep(project, branch, path, pattern, commit?, { page_size, page_pos })
calls.description: lines under `path` matching a regular expression

calls.name: file.blame
calls.description: the Commit of each line

calls.name: file.diff
calls.signature: layerfs.file.diff(project, left_branch, left_path, right_branch, right_path, { left_commit, right_commit })
calls.description: the difference between two files

calls.name: file.write
calls.signature: layerfs.file.write(project, branch, path, content, { message, mode })
calls.description: write a file; one Commit

calls.name: file.edit
calls.signature: layerfs.file.edit(project, branch, path, { old, new, message })
calls.description: replace one unique text in a file; one Commit

calls.name: file.rm
calls.description: remove a path; one Commit

calls.name: file.mkdir
calls.description: make a folder; one Commit

calls.name: file.mv
calls.description: move a path; one Commit

calls.name: file.cp
calls.description: copy a path; one Commit

calls.name: file.apply
calls.description: apply a list of changes; one Commit

calls.name: sandbox.create
calls.description: start a named Sandbox of a project; a sqlite project's runs on its Store's machine

calls.name: sandbox.list
calls.description: every Sandbox in the home, or one project's

calls.name: sandbox.get
calls.description: a Sandbox and its Workspaces

calls.name: sandbox.close
calls.description: stop a Sandbox

calls.name: workspace.mount
calls.description: mount a side Branch in a Sandbox (main is refused: fork a Branch first); name gives the Workspace a handle <sandbox>:<name>

calls.name: workspace.exec
calls.signature: layerfs.workspace.exec(ws, command, { message, stream, stdout, stderr })
calls.description: run one bash command in a Workspace

calls.name: workspace.commit
calls.description: commit a Workspace's changes to its Branch

calls.name: workspace.unmount
calls.description: end a Workspace

calls.name: workspace.status
calls.description: a Workspace's changes since its base

calls.name: machine.list
calls.description: every machine with its state, supports and the Stores and Sandboxes on it; starts none

calls.name: machine.platforms
calls.description: each platform on this host: backend, kernel route, readiness, missing tools and create options

calls.name: machine.get
calls.description: a machine's record

calls.name: machine.status
calls.description: a machine's live state, free disk and tool version

calls.name: machine.start
calls.description: start a stopped machine and its worker; nothing starts one on demand

calls.name: machine.stop
calls.description: stop a machine; InUse while Sandboxes run on it

calls.name: machine.create
calls.signature: layerfs.machine.create(name, platform, { cpus, memory, disk, image, nested, host })
calls.description: create a VM machine

calls.name: machine.connect
calls.signature: layerfs.machine.connect(name, host, { user, port, identity, known_hosts, root })
calls.description: connect an ssh host as a machine

calls.name: machine.remove
calls.description: delete a VM machine and its disk

calls.name: machine.disconnect
calls.description: forget an ssh machine; its data root stays

calls.name: machine.update
calls.description: set a built-in machine's image, Docker socket or WSL distribution

calls.name: store.list
calls.description: every Store, from the home's records

calls.name: store.get
calls.description: a Store's record

calls.name: store.status
calls.description: a Store's live state

calls.name: store.create
calls.description: an empty sqlite Store on native

calls.name: store.connect
calls.description: attach a PostgreSQL database as a Store

calls.name: store.push
calls.description: send a sqlite Store from native to a machine

calls.name: store.pull
calls.description: bring a sqlite Store from its machine back to native

calls.name: store.remove
calls.description: delete a sqlite Store with every project in it

calls.name: store.disconnect
calls.description: forget a PostgreSQL Store; its data stays

calls.name: backup.connect
calls.description: connect an r2 or MinIO bucket

calls.name: backup.disconnect
calls.description: forget a bucket and this home's links to it

calls.name: backup.list

calls.name: backup.restore
